behaviors.name: Clarification Request
behaviors.description: Ask Partner AI to clarify what the current question is asking before answering it.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI clarifies the current question and returns to it.

behaviors.name: Term Definition Request
behaviors.description: Ask Partner AI to define a specific term or phrase from the current question.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI defines the requested term and returns to the current question.

behaviors.name: Example Request
behaviors.description: Ask Partner AI for a concrete example relevant to the current question.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI provides a relevant example and returns to the current question.

behaviors.name: Uncertainty Expression
behaviors.description: Express uncertainty about the answer while remaining related to the current topic.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI recognizes uncertainty and offers clarification or an example.

behaviors.name: Skip Current Item
behaviors.description: Ask to skip the current criterion or primary question and later address it when Partner AI resurfaces skipped material.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI advances, then resurfaces the skipped item before ending the interview.

behaviors.name: Off-Topic Response
behaviors.description: Give an answer unrelated to the configured topic, followed by a contextual recovery answer.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI gently redirects the user to the current topic or question.

behaviors.name: Questions Embedded in Responses
behaviors.description: Exercise a question-only response and questions at the beginning, middle, and end of otherwise substantive responses.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI answers each embedded question and also handles any substantive information in the response.

behaviors.name: Correct Previous Information
behaviors.description: Correct a retained fact from an earlier answer and confirm the revised fact in its original context.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI requests the correction, repeats the updated information in context, confirms it, and resumes the prior interview position.

behaviors.name: Add to Previous Response
behaviors.description: Return to an earlier question, add new retained information, confirm the combined answer, and resume the interview.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI identifies and confirms the prior question, collects the additional information, confirms the combined context, and resumes.

behaviors.name: Earlier Context Reuse
behaviors.description: Provide information that should be useful when Partner AI asks a later related question.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI refers to relevant information collected earlier when asking or framing a later question.

behaviors.name: Potential Contradiction
behaviors.description: Provide information that conflicts with a retained earlier fact, then clarify the intended fact.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI surfaces the potential conflict and asks the user to clarify.

behaviors.name: Fatigue Expression
behaviors.description: Craft a response intended to produce an explicitly assigned Common Ground QFI fatigue range.
behaviors.expectedPartnerAiBehavior: Partner AI takes the action associated with the assigned fatigue range.
